```{r}
closs_nmf <- function(v, param, k_s, k_d, init = "random", flag = 0, 
                      max_iter = 2000, tol = 0.001) {
  # Dimensions and parameters
  m <- nrow(v)
  n <- ncol(v)
  lambda <- param$lammda / 2    # Half of the L2 regularization parameter
  alpha  <- param$alpha         # Laplacian regularization weight for rows
  beta   <- param$beta / 2      # Half of the Laplacian regularization weight for columns
  k      <- param$k            # Latent dimensionality (number of factors)
  sita   <- param$sita         # Scale parameter controlling dropout weighting
  
  # Optional sparsity (L1) regularization parameters for w and h
  lambda_L1_w <- ifelse(is.null(param$lambda_L1_w), 0, param$lambda_L1_w)
  lambda_L1_h <- ifelse(is.null(param$lambda_L1_h), 0, param$lambda_L1_h)
  
  epsilon <- 1e-16  # Small constant to avoid division by zero
  
  # Binary indicator matrices: 
  # 'ct' marks observed (nonzero) entries,
  # 'un' marks dropouts (zeros).
  un <- matrix(as.integer(v == 0), m, n)
  ct <- matrix(as.integer(v > 0), m, n)
  
  # Initialization: use random initialization (or NNDSVD if defined)
  if (init == "random") {
    w <- matrix(runif(m * k, min = 0, max = 1) * 0.1, nrow = m, ncol = k)
    h <- matrix(runif(k * n, min = 0, max = 1) * 0.1, nrow = k, ncol = n)
  } else if (init == "nndsvd") {
    # Assumes that nndsvd_init_parameter is defined elsewhere
    init_res <- nndsvd_init_parameter(v, k, flag)
    w <- init_res$w
    h <- init_res$h
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported initialization method")
  }
  
  # Helper function: reconstruct v from w and h
  reconstruct_v <- function(w, h) {
    w %*% h
  }
  
  # Update m: compute a weighting matrix that adapts to dropout sensitivity.
  # For observed entries (v > 0), weight is set to 1.
  # For zeros, weight decays exponentially with the magnitude of the predicted value.
  update_m <- function(w, h) {
    pre <- reconstruct_v(w, h)
    m_matrix <- matrix(1, m, n)
    # For dropout entries: lower weight if the predicted expression is high
    m_matrix[v == 0] <- exp(-abs(pre[v == 0]) / sita)
    m_matrix
  }
  
  # Update w using multiplicative update rules:
  # - Includes dynamic weighting from m_matrix.
  # - Adds Laplacian regularization via k_d.
  # - Adds an L1 penalty (lambda_L1_w) for sparsity.
  update_w <- function(m_matrix, w, h) {
    term_wh <- w %*% h
    num <- (m_matrix * v) %*% t(h) + alpha * (k_d %*% w)
    den <- (m_matrix * term_wh + lambda * un * term_wh) %*% t(h) +
      alpha * ((w %*% t(w)) %*% w) + epsilon + lambda_L1_w
    w * (num / den)
  }
  
  # Update h using multiplicative update rules:
  # - Incorporates dynamic weighting, Laplacian regularization via k_s,
  #   and an L1 penalty (lambda_L1_h) for sparsity.
  update_h <- function(m_matrix, w, h) {
    term_wh <- w %*% h
    num <- t(w) %*% (m_matrix * v) + beta * (h %*% k_s)
    den <- t(w) %*% (m_matrix * term_wh + lambda * un * term_wh) +
      beta * ((h %*% t(h)) %*% h) + epsilon + lambda_L1_h
    h * (num / den)
  }
  
  # Check for convergence based on relative changes in w and h
  break_iteration <- function(w_old, h_old, w_new, h_new) {
    dw <- max(abs(w_old - w_new)) / (sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) + max(abs(w_old)))
    dh <- max(abs(h_old - h_new)) / (sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) + max(abs(h_old)))
    max(dw, dh) <= tol
  }
  
  # Main training loop: iteratively update m_matrix, w, and h until convergence
  for (i in 1:max_iter) {
    w_old <- w
    h_old <- h
    m_matrix <- update_m(w, h)
    w <- update_w(m_matrix, w, h)
    h <- update_h(m_matrix, w, h)
    if (break_iteration(w_old, h_old, w, h))
      break
  }
  
  list(m = m_matrix, w = w, h = h)
}

```

```{r}
# Example input matrix v and parameters
v <- matrix(sample(0:10, 50000, replace = TRUE), nrow = 100, ncol = 500)
v <- read.csv("mat.csv", header = T) 
rownames(v) <- v$X
v <- v[, -1]
v <- as.matrix(v)
param <- list(lammda = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, beta = 0.1, k = 20, sita = 1)

# For v with dimensions m x n:
k_d <- diag(nrow(v))  # m x m
k_s <- diag(ncol(v))  # n x n

# Run the Closs_NMF algorithm
result <- closs_nmf(v, param, k_s, k_d, max_iter = 100, tol = 0.001)

# Extract the weighting and factor matrices
final_m <- result$m
final_w <- result$w
final_h <- result$h

approx <- final_w %*% final_h
mse <- sum((v - approx)^2) / (nrow(v) * ncol(v))

plot(approx[1:100,1:100], v[1:100,1:100], main = paste("MSE:", mse))


cell_types <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(v), "\\."), function(x) x[1])

# Create the annotation data frame
annotation_col <- data.frame(CellType = factor(cell_types))
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(v)

pheatmap::pheatmap(v, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col)
pheatmap::pheatmap(approx, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col)
```

pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "~/learningR4.3/filtered_gene_bc_matrices/hg19/")

colnames(mat) <- colnames(asdf@assays$RNA)
mat <- as.matrix(mat)

param <- list(lammda = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, beta = 0.1, k = 20, sita = 1)
v <- mat
# For v with dimensions m x n:

k_s <- diag(ncol(v))  # n x n

# Run the Closs_NMF algorithm
result <- closs_nmf(v, param, k_s, k_d, max_iter = 100, tol = 0.001)

# Extract the weighting and factor matrices

final_w <- result$w
final_h <- result$h

approx <- final_w %*% final_h

pheatmap::pheatmap(v, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T, annotation_col = annotation_col)

```{r}
closs_nmf2 <- function(v, k_s, k_d, init = "random", flag = 0,
                       max_iter = 2000, tol = 0.001, lambda = 0.5, 
                       alpha = 0.1, beta = 0.1, k = 20, sita = 1, 
                       tau = 0.1, lambda_L1_w = 0, lambda_L1_h = 0) {
  # Dimensions of the input matrix
  m <- nrow(v)  # number of genes
  n <- ncol(v)  # number of cells

  # Compute gene-specific dropout thresholds if not provided:
  tau.s <- rep(0, m)  # Initialize tau.s
  if (tau != 0) {
    for (i in 1:m) {
      nonzero_vals <- v[i, v[i, ] > 0]
      if (length(nonzero_vals) > 0) {
        tau.s[i] <- tau * mean(nonzero_vals)
      } else {
        tau.s[i] <- tau  # fallback value if no nonzero entries
      }
    }
  }

  epsilon <- 1e-16  # Small constant to avoid division by zero

  # Create binary indicator matrix for dropouts (zeros)
  un <- matrix(as.integer(v == 0), m, n)

  # Initialization: use random initialization (or NNDSVD if specified)
  if (init == "random") {
    w <- matrix(runif(m * k, min = 0, max = 1) * 0.1, nrow = m, ncol = k)
    h <- matrix(runif(k * n, min = 0, max = 1) * 0.1, nrow = k, ncol = n)
  } else if (init == "nndsvd") {
    # Assumes that nndsvd_init_parameter is defined elsewhere
    init_res <- nndsvd_init_parameter(v, k, flag)
    w <- init_res$w
    h <- init_res$h
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported initialization method")
  }

  # Helper function: reconstruct v from w and h.
  reconstruct_v <- function(w, h) {
    w %*% h
  }

  # Update m: compute an adaptive weighting matrix based on dropout sensitivity.
  update_m <- function(w, h) {
    pre <- reconstruct_v(w, h)
    m_matrix <- matrix(1, m, n)
    dropout_idx <- (v == 0)
    for (i in 1:m) {
      idx <- which(dropout_idx[i, ])
      if (length(idx) > 0) {
        m_matrix[i, idx] <- ifelse(abs(pre[i, idx]) < tau.s[i],
                                   epsilon,
                                   exp(-abs(pre[i, idx]) / sita))
      }
    }
    m_matrix
  }

  # Update w using multiplicative update rules, including Laplacian (via k_d) and L1 regularization.
  update_w <- function(m_matrix, w, h) {
    term_wh <- w %*% h
    num <- (m_matrix * v) %*% t(h) + alpha * (k_d %*% w)
    den <- (m_matrix * term_wh + lambda * un * term_wh) %*% t(h) +
      alpha * ((w %*% t(w)) %*% w) + epsilon + lambda_L1_w
    w * (num / den)
  }

  # Update h using multiplicative update rules, including Laplacian (via k_s) and L1 regularization.
  update_h <- function(m_matrix, w, h) {
    term_wh <- w %*% h
    num <- t(w) %*% (m_matrix * v) + beta * (h %*% k_s)
    den <- t(w) %*% (m_matrix * term_wh + lambda * un * term_wh) +
      beta * ((h %*% t(h)) %*% h) + epsilon + lambda_L1_h
    h * (num / den)
  }

  # Initialize a vector to store convergence history.
  conv_history <- numeric(max_iter)

  # Main iterative loop.
  for (i in 1:max_iter) {
    w_old <- w
    h_old <- h
    m_matrix <- update_m(w, h)
    w <- update_w(m_matrix, w, h)
    h <- update_h(m_matrix, w, h)

    # Compute maximum relative change in w and h.
    dw <- max(abs(w_old - w)) / (sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) + max(abs(w_old), epsilon))
    dh <- max(abs(h_old - h)) / (sqrt(.Machine$double.eps) + max(abs(h_old), epsilon))
    conv_history[i] <- max(dw, dh)

    if (conv_history[i] <= tol) {
      conv_history <- conv_history[1:i]  # Trim convergence history
      break
    }
  }

  # Return the final adaptive weight matrix, factor matrices, and convergence history.
  list(m = m_matrix, w = w, h = h, conv_history = conv_history)
}

```

asdf <- FindVariableFeatures(asdf, assay = "RNA", nfeatures = 2000)
mat.ss <- mat[VariableFeatures(asdf), ]

k_s <- cor(t(pca_embeddings))

#k_s <- diag(nrow(mat.ss))  # m x m

k_d <- diag(nrow(mat.ss))  # n x n



param <- list(
  lammda = 0.01,       # Reduced L2 regularization
  alpha = 0.1,         # Laplacian regularization for rows
  beta = 0.1,          # Laplacian regularization for columns
  k = 20,              # Increased number of factors
  sita = .01,          # Increased dropout sensitivity parameter
  lambda_L1_w = 2,  # Reduced L1 for W
  lambda_L1_h = 2   # Reduced L1 for H
)

# Run the Closs_NMF algorithm
result <- closs_nmf2(mat.ss,
                     k_d = k_d, 
                     k_s = k_s, 
                     max_iter = 100, 
                     tol = 0.0001,      
                     lambda = 0.01,
                     alpha = 0.01,         # Laplacian regularization for rows
                     beta = 0.01,          # Laplacian regularization for columns
                     k = 50,              # Increased number of factors
                     sita = 1,          # Increased dropout sensitivity parameter
                     lambda_L1_w = 1,  # Reduced L1 for W
                     lambda_L1_h = 1,  # Reduced L1 for H
                     tau = .1,
                     init = "random") 

# Extract the weighting and factor matrices
final_m <- result$m
final_w <- result$w
final_h <- result$h

approx <- final_w %*% final_h

sum(mat.ss)

mse <- sum((mat.ss - approx)^2) / (nrow(mat.ss) * ncol(mat.ss))
